programs.deprecationReason: Upstream change of nature: in May 2025 Booking.com sent mass termination notices to direct affiliate partners (typical wording: "determined that our current strategic focus unfortunately does not support continuing our partnership") and required migration to network channels. The `?aid=` direct-attribution path on booking.com is no longer the documented onboarding for new partners. Coverage continues under the existing `awin` network-redirect entry. See incident filed via .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/incident-disclosure.yml.

programs.name: Apple Services Performance Partners
programs.notes: Apple's affiliate program — historically the iTunes Affiliate Program, rebranded to Performance Partners with the back-end migrated to Partnerize. The affiliate token travels in `?at=` (max 40 chars per Apple's linking guide). The `?ct=` parameter exists but is the optional campaign-name field, NOT the attribution token, and adopters MUST NOT match on it. Multiple Apple service hostnames carry the same `at` mechanism — listed individually under the exact-host matching rule (SPEC §3.2 step 5). The corporate apex apple.com is intentionally excluded — it does not host commerce surfaces and a partner token there has no effect. The geo.music.apple.com host is the country-redirector front for Apple Music links and is included because publisher tooling (Apple's own Marketing Toolbox) issues `at`-tagged URLs against it.

programs.name: CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction)
programs.notes: CJ Affiliate (formerly Commission Junction) cycles multiple click-tracking domains as an anti-cloaking measure. Publisher links follow the path-based pattern `https://www.{domain}/click-{PID}-{AID}?url={destination}`, where PID is the 7-digit publisher (Promotional Property) ID and AID is the 8-digit ad/link ID; the destination merchant URL travels in `?url=`. CAPS categorisation matches by host alone (SPEC §3.2 step 5); the `param` field documents the destination-URL parameter for completeness, analogous to impact-radius. The 8 domains listed here are the well-documented core cycling pool. CJ has used additional historical domains (apmebf.com, afcyhf.com, ftjcfx.com, lduhtrp.net, tqlkg.com) that are less commonly observed and can be added in a future PR as evidence accumulates. Domain list and link pattern confirmed across multiple independent third-party sources (Adloop URL templates guide, Geniuslink help docs, EFF HTTPS Everywhere atlas, Ghostery WhoTracks.Me); CJ's own developer documentation is gated behind a publisher login, so primary-source confirmation is via real publisher tutorials and tracker indices rather than CJ's dashboard.
